entities.summary: Sir Murray Bisset was a South African Test cricketer and politician. He captained the South African cricket team in 1899 before moving to Southern Rhodesia where he served as Chief Justice of Southern Rhodesia from 1927 to 1931 and briefly as Governor of Southern Rhodesia.
